---
title: "`r paste('PopPK Model Comparison -', params$label_1, 'vs', params$label_2)`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    code_folding: hide
    number_sections: true
    css: style80p.css
params:
  # MANDATORY: Monolix results folders of the two models (summary.txt inside; ChartsData for the plots)
  model_dir_1: "C:/Users/.../model_1"
  model_dir_2: "C:/Users/.../model_2"
  # Optional: names shown in tables and plots (set to "" for the folder names)
  label_1: ""
  label_2: ""
  # Optional: change to TRUE to save tables and plots in addition to the knitted report
  save_output: FALSE
  # Optional: folder of the saved outputs (when save_output is TRUE)
  output_dir: ""
  # Optional: prefix of the saved file names
  prefix: ""
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, fig.align = "center",
                      out.width = "100%")

# Prints a short note instead of stopping the whole report when a section does not apply
# to one of the models (e.g. ChartsData not exported, no standard errors)
safe_run <- function(expr, label) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    cat("*", label, "not available:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r load-functions}
library(mlxflow)
# Used directly by the chunks below (installed together with mlxflow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(patchwork)
```

# Run configuration

```{r run-config}
model_dir_1 <- normalizePath(params$model_dir_1, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
model_dir_2 <- normalizePath(params$model_dir_2, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
label_1 <- if (nzchar(params$label_1)) params$label_1 else basename(model_dir_1)
label_2 <- if (nzchar(params$label_2)) params$label_2 else basename(model_dir_2)
labels  <- c(label_1, label_2)
stem    <- paste0(label_1, "_vs_", label_2)

SAVE_OUTPUTS <- isTRUE(params$save_output)
prefix       <- if (nzchar(params$prefix)) params$prefix else stem
output_dir   <- if (nzchar(params$output_dir)) params$output_dir else file.path(getwd(), paste0(stem, "_comparison"))
if (SAVE_OUTPUTS) dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Saving helpers: do nothing unless save_output = TRUE
save_plot <- function(p, suffix, width = 12, height = 5) {
  if (SAVE_OUTPUTS && !is.null(p)) {
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", suffix, ".png")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  }
  invisible(p)
}
save_table <- function(tbl, suffix) {
  if (SAVE_OUTPUTS && !is.null(tbl)) {
    kableExtra::save_kable(tbl, file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", suffix, ".html")))
  }
  invisible(tbl)
}

cat("Model 1:", label_1, "->", model_dir_1, "\n")
cat("Model 2:", label_2, "->", model_dir_2, "\n")
cat("Saving outputs:", SAVE_OUTPUTS, if (SAVE_OUTPUTS) paste("->", output_dir), "\n")
```

```{r read-models}
s1 <- read_summary(file.path(model_dir_1, "summary.txt"), full = TRUE)
s2 <- read_summary(file.path(model_dir_2, "summary.txt"), full = TRUE)

# The plot-based sections need the ChartsData of BOTH models
has_charts <- vapply(c(model_dir_1, model_dir_2), function(d)
  !inherits(try(check_chartsdata(d), silent = TRUE), "try-error"), logical(1))
if (!all(has_charts)) {
  cat("ChartsData missing for:", paste(labels[!has_charts], collapse = ", "),
      "- the predictive-performance sections are skipped.\n")
}
both_charts <- all(has_charts)
```

# Models

```{r models-overview}
info_value <- function(s, what) {
  v <- s$dataset_info$value[str_detect(s$dataset_info$info, what)]
  if (length(v) == 0) "-" else as.character(v[[1]])
}
overview <- tibble(
  Model         = labels,
  Folder        = basename(c(model_dir_1, model_dir_2)),
  Individuals   = c(info_value(s1, "individuals"), info_value(s2, "individuals")),
  `Covariate relations` = c(length(s1$covariates), length(s2$covariates)),
  `Log-likelihood by`   = c(s1$ll_method, s2$ll_method) |>
    recode(is = "importance sampling", lin = "linearization", .default = "unknown")
)
overview |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Models compared") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Information criteria

OFV, AIC and BIC are only comparable when the log-likelihood of both models was computed the same way.

```{r criteria}
criteria_warning <- NULL
crit <- withCallingHandlers(
  compare_criteria(s1, s2, labels = labels),
  warning = function(w) { criteria_warning <<- conditionMessage(w); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
if (!is.null(criteria_warning)) cat("**Warning:**", criteria_warning, "\n\n")

t_criteria <- crit |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, caption = sprintf("Information criteria (change = %s - %s)", label_2, label_1)) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
save_table(t_criteria, "criteria")
t_criteria
```

# Parameters

Parameters are matched by name: a parameter present in one model only (e.g. a covariate effect) shows a dash for the other.

```{r parameters}
cmp <- compare_two_models(s1, s2, values = c("estimate", "rse_pct"), clean = TRUE)

fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", as.character(signif(as.numeric(x), 3)))
disp <- cmp |>
  transmute(type, parameter,
            est_1 = fmt(estimate_1), est_2 = fmt(estimate_2),
            change = ifelse(is.na(delta_rel_estimate) | delta_rel_estimate == "NA", "\u2014", delta_rel_estimate),
            rse_1 = fmt(rse_pct_1), rse_2 = fmt(rse_pct_2))

t_params <- disp |>
  select(-type) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Parameter", label_1, label_2, "Change", label_1, label_2),
        caption = "Parameter estimates and relative standard errors") |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Estimate" = 2, " " = 1, "RSE (%)" = 2)) |>
  auto_pack_rows(disp, "type") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
save_table(t_params, "parameters")
t_params
```

# Predictive performance

Both models are shown with their own axes: compare the shapes and the spread, not the scales.

```{r obspred-compute, eval=both_charts}
dv_1 <- resolve_dv(model_dir_1)
dv_2 <- resolve_dv(model_dir_2)
op1 <- safe_run(obspred_diagnostics(model_dir_1, dv = dv_1, split = TRUE), paste("Obs vs pred -", label_1))
op2 <- safe_run(obspred_diagnostics(model_dir_2, dv = dv_2, split = TRUE), paste("Obs vs pred -", label_2))
have_op <- !is.null(op1) && !is.null(op2)
```

## Prediction-error metrics

```{r metrics, eval=both_charts}
t_metrics <- NULL
if (have_op) {
  metrics_cmp <- compare_obspred_metrics(op1, op2, labels = labels)
  # Group by observed variable only when there are several
  groups <- c(if (n_distinct(metrics_cmp$Y_TYPE) > 1) "Y_TYPE", "Prediction")
  t_metrics <- metrics_cmp |>
    select(-any_of(c("DV", groups))) |>
    kable(booktabs = TRUE, caption = sprintf("Prediction-error metrics (change = %s - %s)", label_2, label_1),
          col.names = c("Metric", label_1, label_2, "Change")) |>
    auto_pack_rows(metrics_cmp, groups) |>
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"))
  save_table(t_metrics, "metrics")
}
t_metrics
```

## Observations vs predictions

```{r obspred-plot, eval=both_charts, fig.height=5.5}
p_obspred <- NULL
if (have_op) {
  p_obspred <- (op1$obspred + labs(title = label_1)) | (op2$obspred + labs(title = label_2))
  save_plot(p_obspred, "obspred", height = 6)
}
p_obspred
```

## Visual predictive check

```{r vpc, eval=both_charts, fig.height=8}
v1 <- safe_run(plot_vpc(model_dir_1, dv = dv_1, facet_scales = "free", show_observations = TRUE), paste("VPC -", label_1))
v2 <- safe_run(plot_vpc(model_dir_2, dv = dv_2, facet_scales = "free", show_observations = TRUE), paste("VPC -", label_2))
p_vpc <- NULL
if (!is.null(v1) && !is.null(v2)) {
  p_vpc <- (v1 + labs(title = label_1)) / (v2 + labs(title = label_2))
  save_plot(p_vpc, "vpc", height = 10)
}
p_vpc
```
